title: Double-integral estimate for L²-limits of C^1 approximations on B_r
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, 0 < r ≤ 1, f : ℝ^n → ℝ and g : ℝ^n → ℝ^n be a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to B_r = ball(0, r), and let φ_j : ℝ^n → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) be C^1 functions such that ∫⁻_{B_r} ‖φ_j − f‖ₑ² → 0 and ∫⁻_{B_r} ‖∇φ_j − g‖ₑ² → 0 as j → ∞. Then ∫⁻_{x ∈ B_r} ∫⁻_{y ∈ B_r} ‖f(x) − f(y)‖ₑ² dy dx ≤ 2^{n+2} · |B_1| · ∫⁻_{B_r} ‖g‖ₑ², where |B_1| is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball (lintegrals in [0, ∞]).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n) (φ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r)) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) r)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ j)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ j x - f x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖gradient (φ j) x - g x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (n + 2) * volume (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
